# ZebraByte

> ZebraByte provides managed compliance, cyber security and security-first managed infrastructure through one unified service model.

## LLM resources

- [Documentation index for LLMs](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/llms-docs.txt)
- [Complete documentation corpus](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/llms-full.txt)
- [XML sitemap](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/sitemap-index.xml)

For a token-efficient Markdown version of a supported page, request its canonical URL with the `Accept: text/markdown` header.

## Managed Compliance

- [Managed Compliance](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/managed-compliance): Dedicated compliance expertise, controls, evidence, reviews and continuous audit readiness.
- [Compliance Portal](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/compliance-portal): Controlled trust, document and evidence sharing.
- [ISO/IEC 27001](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/iso-27001): ISMS, risk treatment, controls and audit readiness.
- [GDPR & Privacy](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/gdpr): Privacy governance, evidence and technical measures.
- [NIS2 Readiness](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/nis2): Governance, risk management, resilience and incident readiness.
- [Accessibility](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/accessibility): Free accessibility tooling, WCAG assessment guidance and remediation tracking inside the compliance model.

## Cyber Security

- [Cyber Security](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/cyber-security): Main security program and operating model.
- [Security Assessment](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/security-assessment): Review of exposed services, website, domain, email, identity and technical controls with prioritized remediation.
- [Website Security](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/website-security): WAF, DDoS protection, malware monitoring, hardening and recovery.
- [Email Security](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/email-security): SPF, DKIM, DMARC, anti-spoofing, phishing/BEC controls and account hardening.
- [Incident Response](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/incident-response): Triage, containment, eradication, recovery and lessons learned.
- [Secure Managed Hosting](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/secure-hosting): Security-first managed infrastructure, hardening, backups, monitoring and controlled changes.

## Commercial scope

ZebraByte is focused on managed compliance and cyber security. Generic WordPress maintenance, email marketing, broad managed IT and standalone website migration are not promoted as current standalone services.
